title: Launch Milestone Concierge and Release Notes Orchestrator
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Create a lightweight operational layer (the 'Milestone Concierge') that centralizes milestone ownership, automated gating signals, and a single source for release notes aggregation across API, Console, and Runtime streams. Deliverables: 1) canonical milestone map and schedule; 2) templated release notes generator (Markdown + metadata) and editorial workflow; 3) comms calendar for internal and external announcements; 4) cross-team on-call/handover checklist for rollout windows; 5) telemetry gating definitions and quick mitigation playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical milestone map published in Confluence with owners and escalation paths
Release notes templating tool (docs + sample output) approved by PM and Docs leads
Comms calendar integrated into shared team calendar and notifications configured
Automated gating rules for 3 primary telemetry signals implemented in the staging dashboard
Handover checklist validated in a dry-run with Eng, DevEx, and GTM
No outstanding blocker-level dependencies at final cut date
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with Eng (runtime + infra) and Docs. Agreed to split milestones into 'Core API', 'Console UX', 'Serving Runtime' lanes. Action: owners named for each lane (see stakeholders).
2026-02-18: Draft milestone map posted to Confluence https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RT/Milestone+Concierge. Feedback requested from Security and SRE for gating signals.

2026-02-22: Decided to use three telemetry gates: error-rate (p50/p95 anomalies), latency SLO breach probability, and token-cost regression. Engineering to add SLO probes to the staging dashboard (ENG-8421 dependency).

2026-02-25: Release notes templating prototype (Markdown with frontmatter) pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1321. Docs lead (Ava Chen) requested an extra field for 'customer-facing impact'.
2026-02-27: Dry-run scheduled for 2026-03-03 to validate handover checklist and comms cadence. Blocking: one runtime canary job failing intermittently; SRE investigating (INC-2026-09 referenced).
2026-03-01: Updated milestone map with revised cut-window: primary cut is 03/10, reserve window 03/13. Noted downstream dependency on PM-6147 for release gate playbook alignment.
risks: Telemetry gating thresholds are noisy during load tests — mitigation: add smoothing and require sustained breaches for 10m before blocking
Docs throughput — release notes may lag if engineers provide incomplete PR summaries; mitigation: template enforcement and a Docs triage slot
Cross-team alignment slip — staggered cut windows reduce blast radius but complicate comms; mitigation: concierge will publish per-lane cut decisions and fallback rules
rollout_plan_summary: Phase 1: Internal cut with Canary for API endpoints (03/10). Phase 2: Console feature flags ramped to 25% (03/11-03/12). Phase 3: Full runtime capacity switch with fallback to older quantized model if SLOs breach (03/13 reserve window). Each phase gated by telemetry and signoff from lane owner + SRE.
notes: Next: complete dry-run and capture time-to-signoff metrics to validate cut windows
Follow-up: implement minor UX change to release notes format based on Docs feedback
Post-release: run a lessons-learned retrospective and publish a 1-page summary linked from the playbook
